_comment: C1 contract fixture — resolve → exchange_code issuance + JWT redemption

response_403_not_org_member.message: User is not a member of this organization

response_409_cluster_invalid_state.message: Cluster is not in a resolvable state (provisioning_failed / terminated)

response_401_code_consumed.message: Exchange code was already consumed or never existed

jwt_verify.kid_source: JWT header kid → match against JWKS key id
jwt_verify.signature: ExchangeService rebuilds signing KeyPair from MongoDB ACTIVE key on every call (rotation-aware, no bean-cache)
jwt_verify.verify_side: SDK CloudControlPlaneSdk.verifyJwt — caches JWKS from /v1/api/jwks.json, refreshes every 5min

jwks_endpoint.format: RFC 7517 JSON Web Key Set — one entry per non-expired key (ACTIVE + PREVIOUS)
jwks_endpoint.kid: MongoDB JwksKey.kid (e.g. 'key-2026-09-29'), dynamically generated by JwksRotationService
jwks_endpoint.rotation: 24h interval, 24h overlap window (PREVIOUS key kept until expiresAt)
